about_the_game:
Embark on an unpredictable journey with Ash through love, friendship, and supernatural chaos.

Love is a Demon is a narrative adventure game that takes you on a heartfelt and hilarious ride through the complexities of romance and personal growth. Step into the shoes of Ash, an introverted dreamer finally ready to confess their feelings to their best friend, Ivy. But just as everything seems to fall into place, an unforeseen supernatural event throws their world into chaos.

  • Live the Story – Explore Ash’s world through immersive, interactive moments that pull you deeper into their journey.

  • Shape the Narrative – Every choice you make influences Ash’s relationships and leads to different outcomes.

  • Laugh & Cringe – Enjoy witty dialogue, quirky interactions, and absurd situations that make love feel messier than ever.

  • Emotional Journey: Explore love, friendship, and self-discovery through relatable moments that resonate with your heart.

  • Solve & Explore: Solve fun puzzles that reflect the ups and downs of Ash’s journey.

  • Multiple Endings: Your decisions shape Ash’s path and determine the outcomes of their love story.

  • Character Exploration: Build relationships, uncover backstories, and explore how each character’s dynamics influence the journey.

Will Ash find the courage to confess, or will otherworldly chaos derail their plans?

Your choices. Your love life. Your demonic mess.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized nudity in suggestive contexts (without explicit content), a character in revealing clothing, mild horror elements, and references to alcohol.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU 2.40GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Love is a Demon is an adventure game packed with romance, chaos, and supernatural surprises. Confess your crush, dodge demons, and embrace the mess—love has never been this complicated. Your choices shape Ash’s love life in this heartfelt, hilarious story-driven experience.
